from contextlib import contextmanager
import time

@contextmanager
def timer(label):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    yield
    print(f"{label}: {time.perf_counter() - start:.3f}s")

import asyncio

async def fetch(n):
    await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
    return n * 2

async def main():
    results = await asyncio.gather(*(fetch(i) for i in range(5)))
    print(results)

asyncio.run(main())
